translations.web: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
translations.bsb: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
translations.kjv: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
translations.asv: And out of the smoke came forth locusts upon the earth; and power was given them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
